purpose: Close or retain OMS-005B after a final search for buyer-side measurable overseas field-service residuals and incumbent execution routes.

buyer_side_cost.actor: 江苏佳成科技股份有限公司
buyer_side_cost.observed_fact: Company service page says overseas onsite service is generally arranged 1–2 weeks after visa completion, while domestic onsite can be within 24h.
buyer_side_cost.interpretation: Cross-border engineer dispatch creates a real response-latency gap.

buyer_side_cost.observed_fact: A multi-million-value international order was blocked by batch quality problems; goods could not be returned domestically for rework, so an overseas rework line was built from scratch. The company later developed overseas technical service points, local service providers and standard processes; overseas after-sales response reportedly shortened about 40%.
buyer_side_cost.interpretation: Local execution capability can materially reduce emergency overseas rework/response cost.

buyer_side_cost.observed_fact: Provider research claims single-project overseas engineer dispatch costs roughly RMB150k–300k and overseas response commonly takes 5–14 days versus customer expectations of 24–48h.
buyer_side_cost.interpretation: Directional economic evidence only; vendor-generated and not treated as independent buyer proof.

incumbent_execution_routes.route: Local teams in Japan/Thailand provide overseas delivery, installation, commissioning, production support, inspections and after-sales to equipment manufacturers.

incumbent_execution_routes.actor: 江苏领创电气科技有限公司
incumbent_execution_routes.route: Offers overseas project installation/commissioning, long-term O&M outsourcing and local service capability co-building.

incumbent_execution_routes.actor: 江苏泰信机械股份有限公司
incumbent_execution_routes.route: Uses own overseas service team together with local Caterpillar service engineers in overseas service work.

incumbent_execution_routes.actor: 云维保 / 驼驮维保 / FSM platforms
incumbent_execution_routes.route: Domestic industrial-service marketplaces already route industrial engineers, quotes, work orders and acceptance; software mechanics are mature.

rationale: The buyer pain is real: response latency, travel cost, rework and onsite acceptance matter.
The supply side is real and actively selling local execution.
But multiple incumbent models already bridge OEMs to local execution by geography/industry.
A generic China-side engineer marketplace or overseas service broker would face mature alternatives and bypass risk.
The remaining possible edge is too narrow/enterprise-specific to justify founder attention without direct payer evidence.

rooter_fit.attractive_part: Task schema + qualification + routing + acceptance + provider replacement is structurally aligned with the operator.
rooter_fit.unattractive_part: Current acquisition still looks like enterprise-by-enterprise BD into a market where direct local-service partners already sell the same outcome.
rooter_fit.operator_exit: Plausible technically, but demand self-propulsion is not evidenced.

kill_conditions_satisfied: Existing providers can deliver local installation/commissioning/O&M in target geographies.
The surviving value increasingly collapses into provider sourcing/BD rather than a unique missing edge.
Current demand pump would require founder-led enterprise acquisition.

portfolio_effect.next_search_direction: Resume broad high-mobilization scanning for flows with strong bilateral pull where incumbent routes do not already provide the minimum service unit.
search_preferences: incumbent route incomplete at the exact minimum service unit
